posts.title: Closing summary
posts.text: This concludes our live coverage of the 2026 midterms for the day. Here are the latest developments: Barack Obama campaigned for Senate hopeful Abdul El-Sayed in Detroit today. “Change is in the air,” the former president said of the 2026 midterms, in a speech that laid aim at the Trump administration and called on…

Reporting from Manchester, New Hampshire With 10 days until the midterms election, New Hampshire has caused some eleventh-hour consternation for Democrats when it comes to the competitive Senate race. Chris Pappas, the four-term Democratic congressman who is vying for the open seat, took to the stage in Manchester…

Barack Obama concluded his remarks at Abdul El-Sayed’s rally in Detroit, saying: “Michigan, you and I have proved before that it’s hard to stop change when it’s time has come. So I’m asking you to do it again in 10 days.”

“These are unsettling times,” Barack Obama said in his address at Abdul El-Sayed’s rally in Detroit, urging voters to elect “serious” candidates who share their values. The former president noted that the economy is changing fast, artificial intelligence is set to change the world and the United States is facing a…

Barack Obama encouraged voters to elect Democratic governors and members of Congress in November’s midterms to check the Trump administration. “This election is our last, best chance to at least reign in some of the foolishness of this administration,” Obama said.

posts.title: Obama says Trump 'excels at grifting'
posts.text: Barack Obama criticized Donald Trump for profiting off the presidency during his address in Detroit. “We have never seen a president straight-up excel at grifting on your dime like this,” Obama said. “We have lost count of all the deals he and his family have done.”

“He should be on HGTV,” Obama said of Donald Trump’s many renovations in Washington, including the White House ballroom and Rose Garden. “He’s got the White House looking like Saddam Hussein opened a Cheesecake Factory.”
“Don’t boo, vote,” Barack Obama repeated throughout his speech in Michigan, responding when rally goers booed at Obama’s description of current policies being pursued by the Trump administration.

Barack Obama criticized Donald Trump from levying tariffs and starting trade wars with “that well known evil empire, Canada.” “These are the people who gave us Martin Short and Maple syrup. They are the nicest people," Obama said.

posts.title: Obama: Pete Hegseth and other officials are 'not serious people'
posts.text: Barack Obama called Pete Hegseth and other Trump administration officials “not serious people.” Obama said the secretary of defense was more concerned about “the jawline and testosterone levels of our troops” and “livestreaming executions” than ending the war in Iran. “How much time do you think this man spends in…

Barack Obama criticized “the current occupant of the White House”' and his 2024 campaign promises “to keep costs down” during his appearance in Detroit. “I don’t have to tell you how tough things are out there, you’re living it,” Obama said, echoing the Democratic Party’s affordability message that has driven this…

Barack Obama criticized the last “ten years of chaos and cruelty and corruption and incompetence, tomfoolery, nonsense, the likes of which this country has not seen in modern times at least” during his address in Detroit.
